results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. results.content: Civiqs has been tracking this since the day Trump took the oath, and as of late July, Trump’s net approval in Texas sits at -13. Texas is one of eleven states Trump carried by double digits in 2024 where he’s now underwater, in the “should have been safe but isn’t” column. [...] Then there’s The Economist and YouGov, who ran their own state-by-state model in late August and found something even uglier. Trump is underwater in 47 out of 50 states, and Texas is sitting at -22. Nationally, the two outfits aren’t even measuring the same planet. Civiqs has him at -24. YouGov has him worse, at -26.
